messages:
Alice_NG: Heads up — onboarding bootcamp tenant 'Nova' needs bulk GPU capacity in ap-west-2. Planning p5 x12, p4d x4 and g5 x40 across three accounts. We also need ENI and SNAT capacity increases and a soft accelerator entitlement bump. Any blockers?

Ben_Infra: What exact scale per account and launch window?

Alice_NG: Accounts: 123456789012, 210987654321, 333222111000. Launch window: week of May 4, ramp over ~48h. Peak concurrent instances ~50.

Irene_Ops: Noted. ENI-per-instance for these families is 1 but ENI ceilings are per-account AZ allocation — we'll need ENI ceiling + extra Elastic IPs for SNAT. I'll open the AWS case. Any preference on IPv6 fallback?

Alice_NG: No IPv6 dependency for this tenant. IPv4 SNAT IPs preferred.

Mike_Network: Heads up on NAT GW throughput — default NAT per-AZ is ~10Gbps but sharing across tenants can bite. If they saturate, plan for additional NAT GW or NAT instances. Estimate sustained egress ~1.2-1.5 Gbps/account during peak.

Ben_Infra: Quick cost sanity: p5 ~= $X/hr, p4d ~= $Y/hr, g5 ~= $W/hr. Back-of-envelope steady-state cost ~ $Z/day (subject to exact instance mix). Finance needs a heads-up.

Irene_Ops: Drafting support case. Using this template to speed AWS review:

````
Request: Increase EC2 Accelerator quotas (p5, p4d, g5) + ENI and Elastic IP ceilings for accounts: [123456789012, 210987654321, 333222111000]
Desired quotas: p5: 12, p4d: 4, g5: 40 (burst to 60), ENI: +200, Elastic IPs (for SNAT): +50
Reason: Bootcamp tenant will run parallel inference jobs with short ramp. Need AZ spread and predictable allocation to avoid placement failures.
Sustained baseline: ~30 instances concurrently for 72h, peak 50. Estimated egress per account: 1.2 Gbps sustained.
Impact if denied: jobs will fail to place, causing missed deadlines and customer SLA impact for the bootcamp cohort.
````

Irene_Ops: Created AWS support case #9876543210 (normal). Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/#9876543210

aws-support-bot: Case #9876543210 created (Severity: normal). Contact: irene@redwood.ai

Alice_NG: Thanks — I'll pause tenant launches until we get confirmation. Can we define a fallback region (eu-west-2) if ap-west-2 is delayed?

Mike_Network: We have a cold pool in eu-west-2; cross-region data replication and routing are supported. Need to confirm data residency is OK with the customer.

Alice_NG: Data residency cleared by compliance. :thumbsup:

Ben_Infra: I'll run an infra preflight tomorrow 14:00 UTC — subnet sizing, AZ allocation checks, route tables, NAT GW counts, and placement policy.

Irene_Ops: AWS replied requesting justification + sustained baseline numbers. Sent follow-up with traffic patterns and job durations.

Alice_NG: Follow-up sent. keeping fingers crossed.

Ben_Infra: Looping in finance for provisional sign-off @sara_finance

sara_finance: Saw this — provisional spend approved for the bootcamp window. Please circulate the one-pager cost breakout after preflight.

Alice_NG: Will share the one-pager today. Thanks all.
